New pilots will be selected at the workshop on 26 August. This page gathers the practical arrangements and the preparations.

> **⚠ Working draft as of 28 July 2026.** The content is compiled from the workshop material and has **not been decided**. The compilation is editorial. Input and corrections are welcome.

## Dates

| Date | What |
|---|---|
| 5 August 2026 | The case descriptions are sent to all participants, with a request for feedback on whether the content is adequate and for proposed clarifications or changes. |
| 25 August 2026 | All case descriptions are reviewed in the architecture group. |
| 26 August 2026 | Workshop at Gardermoen (3.5 hours). |

## How the workshop works

Participants distribute themselves across groups – one per case – and outline how the pilot could be carried out. If no one signs up for a case, it will not be worked on. Results are presented in plenary.

The groups work on three questions:

1. What is the goal of the pilot in the first three-month cycle?
2. What should the pilot produce? Dream journey, information and data models, data products, high-level architecture, solution design, prototypes, frameworks and more.
3. What competence is needed, and how will it be obtained?

The most important thing to settle is **who will take the lead** on each case.

## Selection

This time the selection places more weight on **feasibility and the partners' ability to contribute** than on finding the "right" case – the main constraint has been capacity to carry pilots out, not a shortage of good needs.

See [Pilot candidates](https://docs.samt-bu.no/en/prosjektstyring/workshop-26-august-2026/pilotkandidater/) for the candidates that have been sent out.
